introduction: Explore Rogue Plains, its tribal stronghold, undead camp, giant summit and demon realm. Seven story outcomes cover all nine local exchanges. Active, ready accounting is required. Supplied exact proof remains valid; words, source recovery, access and actual effects need separately qualified events.
orientation: Meet actual recipients before asking addressed words. Sijona answers hi/hello; the reaper answers hi/hello and staff. The other recipes are explained by native descriptions and journal guidance; do not invent a keyword achievement or an unimplemented NPC reply.

The mediator has two independent requests. Recover the lost medal from the obelisk for bracers, or gather one cloud promise and one storm promise for the hammer. Obelisk access uses the persistent obsidian key from Mabus or successful lockpicking. A supplied medal fits without carrying the key or recording an unlock.

The two tribal witchdoctors supply different silence-potion kinds with identical names. Either kind fits either giant. Give one potion to the cloud giant and a separate potion to the storm giant for two different promises. Both recipes for each giant share one outcome; consuming one potion cannot supply both giants.

Cloud and storm promises have identical visible names but distinct identities. The mediator requires one of each; a supplied matching pair fits without personally collecting either promise. His dialogue promises a sword, while the native reward is the hammer of titankind. This mismatch is pending builder review.

The wandering orc needs four different buffalo-flesh kinds, then gives two hides and leaves. A common kind has several sources; three rarer kinds come from different buffalo instances in the southern and eastern plains. All look identical, and not every buffalo carries every kind. The journal labels source kinds separately. The flesh is currently typed as a cure-light potion despite meat prose; changing that is a pending native decision.

The hiking boots are worn by one stronghold sentinel. The sage trades them for only part of his soul. Bring that exact soul plus finger bones from one hand of death to the reaper. Supplied souls fit without the boots history. The staff-named reward is a create-dracolich wand; its spell needs a sufficiently powerful corpse in the same room, valid form and available control capacity. Receipt or device activation alone does not prove raising a controlled dracolich or fulfilling the sage's climb.

Sijona points to Balance in Myrabolus. The chieftain, archnecromancer and Mabus carry light, undeath and evil tokens. Balance on the Myrabolus pier accepts one of each for four rewards under a foreign-owned contract. This local journal provides referral guidance without duplicating credit or treating possession as personal defeat of all forces.

Find and open the secret cliff, corpse-mound and summit routes. Their resets are secret and closed rather than locked or blocked. The corpse-mound wording does not add a magical block. The locked obelisk and altar are separate containers; the altar's persistent bone key comes from the archnecromancer. Key possession is not successful passage.

The pit enters the Styx, and two yurts enter interiors with ordinary exits. Three identically named flaming portals in the demon chamber lead to different plains locations. Actual portal identity and return route matter; a name match alone cannot identify the intended destination. No portal or arrival achievement is implemented here.

Cloudscape entry permits flight or levitation, but horizontal movement out of an air-plane room requires flight; levitation alone only supports vertical exits. Mounted travel checks the mount. Set effects, aerial arrival and a safe return need actual accepted effects and movement events.

Two R resets create the horselords' mounts. Equipment and inventory following R targets the mount; the patrol witchdoctor is a follower. Keva, the windtalker, Lifebane and the lich have ordinary resets in connected staging rooms and can wander. Source descriptions refer to load origins, not guaranteed current rooms.

The Master sigil has a real worn periodic procedure and an alternative foreign source with a shared stock cap. Its direct legacy procedure counts matching worn slots, caps at six, and adds benefits starting at two pieces. A separate adapter table lists an eighth member, but the sigil is directly assigned to the legacy path. Equipping one sigil is not proof of a full set or actual durable effect.

Two surface approaches are reciprocal. A separate northern exit names a room absent from the active static world inventory and present only in historical data; qualify the deployed assembly before selecting any repair. This optional boundary does not make the two existing approaches absent.

All nine native contracts retain potential daily shape, while grouping each giant's alternative recipes leaves seven authored candidates. Orc retirement, reset conditions, shared stock, recipient survival, access and ready accounting still govern actual repeats. Hides have trapper prose but no observed continuation; no full-zone Balance or Master campaign terminal is invented.

contacts.name: Sijona, assistant of Balance
contacts.description: Sijona behind the secret cliff trail refers restored Balance to her mentor in Myrabolus. Three local tokens feed that foreign-owned exchange; her greeting itself is not an award.

contacts.name: a titan mediator
contacts.description: Titan mediator at the giant summit accepts the lost medal independently, or one promise from each giant. The actual second reward is a hammer despite sword dialogue.

contacts.name: a wandering orc
contacts.description: Wandering orc starts beyond the demon camp and can cross zone boundaries. Four distinct buffalo-flesh kinds give two hides, then he leaves.

contacts.name: an old tribal sage
contacts.description: Old tribal sage by the giant-mountain approach exchanges hiking boots for a partial soul. His climb has no separate accepted endpoint.

contacts.name: a bickering cloud giant
contacts.description: Cloud giant at the summit accepts either potion kind for the cloud promise. The two recipes are alternatives, not two achievements.

contacts.name: a bickering storm giant
contacts.description: Storm giant at the summit accepts either potion kind for the distinct storm promise. The mediator needs one of each promise.

contacts.name: a soul reaper
contacts.description: Soul reaper in the bone yard answers hi/hello and staff. Partial soul plus finger bones gives a staff-named wand; no raising ritual is recorded.

contacts.name: an ebriham sentinel
contacts.description: Two stronghold sentinels start together; one wears the exact hiking boots. Matching appearance does not guarantee both instances carry them.

contacts.name: a hand of death
contacts.description: Three hands of death start in the undead camp; only one declared instance carries the required finger bones.

contacts.name: a huge buffalo
contacts.description: Ten huge buffalo placements supply five common strips and three distinct rarer kinds. Four matching names do not make the kinds interchangeable.

contacts.name: a tribal witchdoctor
contacts.description: Stronghold witchdoctor supplies one silence-potion kind inside the entered yurt.

contacts.name: a tribal witchdoctor
contacts.description: Other witchdoctor starts as a follower in the mounted patrol and supplies the alternative potion kind. Follow actual patrol location rather than assuming the load room is permanent.

contacts.name: the ebriham chieftain
contacts.description: Ebriham chieftain carries the token of light for Balance in Myrabolus; it is not a local quest offering.

contacts.name: the archnecromancer
contacts.description: Archnecromancer carries the undeath token and persistent bone key for the locked altar. The altar rod is not a local quest delivery.

contacts.name: Mabus
contacts.description: Mabus carries the evil token and obsidian key. The nearby obelisk holds the mediator's medal and foreign loot.

contacts.name: Keva
contacts.description: Keva is loaded in a connected staging room and can wander. She wears the Master sigil; acquisition alone does not grant a set-effect achievement.

contacts.name: the windtalker
contacts.description: Windtalker is loaded in a connected cloud-side staging room and can wander. Ordinary equipment and aerial access have no native quest finale.

contacts.name: an ebriham horselord
contacts.description: Two Ebriham horselords start with R-loaded steeds and followers. Subsequent equipment/inventory belongs to the actual most recently loaded mobile.

contacts.name: an ebriham steed
contacts.description: R-loaded Ebriham steeds are actual mounts: horseshoes after the first R and saddle after the second R target the mount, not its rider.

contacts.name: an ebriham horseman
contacts.description: Horsemen start as patrol followers. Mount/follower movement and source custody need actual runtime qualification.

contacts.name: a newborn dracolich
contacts.description: Newborn dracolich has an ordinary bone-yard reset. Lore about raising it does not create a staff-use or ritual completion.

contacts.name: a lifebane
contacts.description: Lifebane starts in a connected staging room with Keva. An ordinary wandering source is not automatically missing or quest-controlled.

contacts.name: a lich warlock
contacts.description: Lich starts with phantom followers in a connected staging room. Their ordinary placement does not define a resolution contract.

contacts.name: Balance
contacts.description: Balance, the bounty hunter on the Myrabolus pier, accepts the three exact Rogue tokens. His contract belongs to Myrabolus; a local referral does not duplicate its achievement or certify all personal kills.
